title: Free version is okay but premium is too expensive
author: Adri0409

title: Awsome!
body: I’ve been using “everyday” for more than a year now and I still love it! So simple, yet very telling and versatile, easy to use and visually appealing. Makes me feel want to open the app and register my progress every day, and make those colors dark! Very motivating habit tracker. Thank you.
author: M2013t
